request.query: Clearing denominators of integer multivariate polynomial evaluation yields integer Liouville inequality

items.name: one_le_pow_mul_abs_eval_div
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {a b : ℤ},
  0 < b →
    Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f) ≠ 0 →
      1 ≤ ↑b ^ f.natDegree * |Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f)|

items.name: DenomsClearable
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {K : Type u_2} → [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : CommSemiring K] → R → R → ℕ → Polynomial R → (R →+* K) → Prop

items.name: denomsClearable_of_natDegree_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring K] {i : R →+* K} {b : R} {bi : K} (N : ℕ)
  (a : R), bi * i b = 1 → ∀ (f : Polynomial R), f.natDegree ≤ N → DenomsClearable a b N f i

items.name: Liouville.exists_pos_real_of_irrational_root
items.type:
∀ {α : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    ∀ {f : Polynomial ℤ},
      f ≠ 0 →
        Polynomial.eval α (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ ℝ) f) = 0 →
          ∃ A, 0 < A ∧ ∀ (a : ℤ) (b : ℕ), 1 ≤ (↑b + 1) ^ f.natDegree * (|α - ↑a / (↑b + 1)| * A)

items.name: denomsClearable_C_mul_X_pow
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring K] {i : R →+* K} {b : R} {bi : K} {N : ℕ}
  (a : R), bi * i b = 1 → ∀ {n : ℕ} (r : R), n ≤ N → DenomsClearable a b N (Polynomial.C r * Polynomial.X ^ n) i

items.name: Liouville.transcendental
items.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, Liouville x → Transcendental ℤ x

items.name: LiouvilleWith.ne_cast_int
items.type: ∀ {p x : ℝ}, LiouvilleWith p x → 1 < p → ∀ (m : ℤ), x ≠ ↑m
